_schema.description: Source-row-anchored trace tests for Phase 4 IE ingest (Codex round-10). Each entry pins a specific (source_table, source_form_type, filing_id, source_line_item, source_tran_id) row to its expected attribution outcome. Confirms the end-to-end pipeline (extract -> attribute -> resolve -> persist) on known transactions. Manual-eyeball backstop for the kind of bug shared-code reconciles can miss (e.g. the round-11 AG-queue misattribution).

expn_f461p5_post_fix_uber_quarantines.notes: Round-11 AG-queue bug regression test. Uber's $30M IE for Protect App-Based Drivers (pre-Prop-22 filing dated 2019-10-30) carries row_bal_num='19-0026' (Attorney General queue ID, not prop number). Pre-fix this wrongly attributed to PROP_19_2020. Post-fix it correctly quarantines because BAL_NAME 'Protect App-Based Drivers and Services' has no 'Proposition NN' keyword and the resolver doesn't have a curated override for this committee. Demonstrates: AG-queue rejection works, AND we have a follow-up opportunity to manually attribute via known_unattributed_vehicles registry.

dedup_s496_loses_to_s496_winner.notes: Dedup collision: this S496 row collides with another S496 row (flow_id 273686, filing_id 1135136) on identical economic_fingerprint. The dedup pass picks the first by source_fingerprint string tiebreaker. Demonstrates dedup pass marks loser correctly and preserves winner pointer. NOTE: dedup losers retain their original attribution (finance_campaign_id + stance) for audit provenance — quarantine_reason flags the elimination but the row remembers what it WOULD have attributed to. Aggregation queries filter by `WHERE quarantine_reason IS NULL` to skip dedup losers.
